# Meta-Analysis with R

This course introduces reproducible meta-analysis workflows in R for systematic reviews and evidence synthesis.

## Target Audience

Clinicians, researchers, PhD students, public health professionals, and analysts preparing systematic reviews, meta-analyses, or evidence synthesis reports.

## Practical Information

| Item | Information |
|---|---|
| Format | Online |
| Schedule | Monday, Wednesday, Friday |
| Time | 17:00-19:00 Morocco time |
| Price | 1500 DH |
| Seats | 20 participants maximum |
| Registration | Opens 10 days before course start |

## Learning Objectives

By the end of this course, participants will be able to:

- prepare extracted study data for meta-analysis;
- compute and interpret common effect sizes;
- assess heterogeneity and model choice;
- create forest plots and summary tables;
- document reproducible evidence synthesis workflows in R.
